notes.title: End of game
notes.content:
Our new End of game game is available on the VK Play platform!
Who wants to play a new, interesting horror from our company, follow the link - https://vkplay.ru/play/game/end_of_game/

There will be an action soon, so hurry up!

notes.title: Bug fixes.
notes.content:
Various bugs and problems with the passage of the game have been fixed.
We wish you a happy new year!!!

Sincerely, KronEngineCompany.

notes.title: Nominate for an award on Steam.
notes.content:
Dear friends! 

We are glad that our game already has so many users! 
Based on this, we ask you to nominate Find a way out: Abode of Darkness for an award on Steam. 
Many thanks to the fans of our first game on computers.

[expand type=details]Our group in VK - https://vk.com/kronenginecompany
Our website/blog - https://kronenginecompany.business.blog/[/expand]

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]English language[/b][/h1]

Here's an update for our English-speaking users. The project has been translated to 100% and is ready to play. Report bugs [url=https://vk.com/kronenginecompany]here[/url].

[h1][b]New items and fixes[/b][/h1]

[olist]
[*] A sight has been added to the game for convenience. (you can enable it in the game settings). Who is for realism, you can not include :)
[*] One of the two monsters was removed to simplify the game. (monsters on the 1st and 2nd floor).
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/olist]

Our group in VK - https://vk.com/kronenginecompany

notes.title: English language!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We decided to add English localization to the game. This decision was made on the basis of requests from our English-speaking friends (users).

Sincerely, KronEngineCompany.

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
[h1]A large number of fixes[/h1]

[olist]
[*] Monsters on the roof now walk, attack and can descend the stairs.
[*] Zombies in the dungeon now do not stand in one place, but wander and attack you.
[*] Monsters on the first and second floor will not get stuck (improvements are possible).
[*] The task of cleaning the roof became possible to perform.
[*] Significant improvements and corrections.
[/olist]

notes.title: Discount in honor of the release!
notes.content:
[h1]Discount 10%[/h1]

The game does not cost much and therefore 10% in honor of the release of the game is quite enough! 
There are 2 days and 15 hours left before the release.  

Sincerely, KronEngineCompany.

notes.title: Updating the AI.
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mutants are now on the 1-2 floor![/b][/h1]

We are in a hurry to inform you that an AI update has been released, or rather:
[olist]
[*] Zombies have become smarter.
[*] Now there are more infected.
[*] Mutants have now appeared on the 1st and 2nd floor.
[*] (not exactly) fixed a bug with a mutant on the 3rd floor and mutants on the roof.
[/olist]

[h2][u]Minor innovations.[/u][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Steam Auto-Cloud has been connected and now your game progress will not be lost.
[*] Some bugs with the elevator were identified and fixed. (if bugs are detected, report here - kronengine@list.ru).
[/olist]

Sincerely, KronEngineCompany.

notes.content:
